title: The impact of social support on quality of life in Chinese parents of children with autism spectrum disorder: the mediating role of resilience
keywords: parents of children with autism spectrum disorder
core_idea: To examine whether resilience mediates the relationship between social support and quality of life among Chinese parents of children with autism spectrum disorder, using standardized Chinese versions of the SSRS, CD‑RISC, and WHOQOL‑BREF and mediation analysis on data collected from 257 hospital‑recruited parents.
tldr: This study investigates the mediating role of resilience in the association between social support and quality of life for Chinese parents of children with autism, using survey instruments and mediation analysis on a sample of 257 parents.
